audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer gives Fizz all 7 chart rows; content and packet both read Skill x4, Malzahar at 6 and first item, Skill late. 48.44% WR supports the mostly-even read, not a 7/0 sweep.
audit.why: Blanket 'Fizz' template on the full layer contradicts the content layer row by row.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content/packet: Skill L1-4/5, Malzahar at 6 and first item, Skill at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] names Malzahar's passive 'Void Shield' — Riot's name is Void Shift (packet suspectNames flagged it).
audit.corrected: Void Shift. Spike structure itself (Fizz E-hold pre-6, Malz edge at 6 with passive+voidlings vs shark, coin-flip late on E-vs-R timing) is sound.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood tells you to 'poke his shield off' — Fizz has no shield; the shield template belongs to a different enemy. cooldowns field has no digit. Missing: Fizz's combo opens with a Seastone Trident auto-reset wind-up, the real step-back tell.
audit.why: Template bleed plus lint-confirmed gaps; his E (16s rank 1, 8 max) untargetability dodging Nether Grasp is the defining interaction and is already present.
audit.corrected: Trade around his 400-range E and 550-range Q dash; E is 16/14/12/10/8s — the whiffed hop is the kill window; W auto-reset wind-up is the burst tell.

edits.before: Late Malz is a number: one suppression on their carry equals one won teamfight. Shield up, flank smart, press R.
edits.after: Late is a coin-flip on his E timing versus your R — bait the hop with a voidling, then the suppression wins it.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Poke-and-punish: E him when he steps up to CS, Q-silence the follow-up — his 400-range E is his only out, and burning it on a trade leaves him hopless.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Standing inside his 550-range Q dash with your shield down — his W-empowered burst deletes the squishiest scaling mage in the pool.

edits.before: Set the metronome: E the wave, shield-manage the poke, and silence only what matters. You are not dueling anyone — you are billing them for tempo.
edits.after: Set the metronome: E the wave and watch his hands — his combo opens with a Seastone Trident auto-reset wind-up; that, not the cast, is your step-back cue.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Check it before every step-up. - spell shield (Iron Boundary) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Playful / Trickster (E): 16s at rank 1, 8 at max — the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo, so bait it before spending burst and check it before every step-up. - The spell shield is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - Nether Grasp 140/110/80s answers fights, not waves.
